text: Life Insurance Policies: Term life insurance covers the policyholder for a specific term (e.g., 10, 20, or 30 years). If the policyholder dies within this term, the beneficiaries receive the payout. Permanent life insurance includes whole life and universal life, offering lifetime coverage with a cash value component.

Life Insurance Exclusions: Suicide within the first two years of the policy, death resulting from illegal acts, and death due to undeclared dangerous hobbies (like skydiving) are generally not covered.

Health & Medical Coverage: Comprehensive health plans cover inpatient hospital stays, outpatient care, prescription drugs, and preventive services like annual physicals and vaccinations with zero copay.
Medical Pre-existing Conditions: Pre-existing conditions are covered under all standard medical plans with no waiting period, subject to ACA compliance guidelines.

Auto Insurance: Comprehensive coverage pays for damage to your car caused by events other than collisions (e.g., theft, fire, vandalism). Collision coverage pays for damage caused by hitting another vehicle or object.
Vehicle Liability: Bodily injury liability covers medical expenses for others if you are at fault in an accident. Property damage liability covers repairs to the other party's vehicle or property.
Property & Home: Homeowners insurance covers the structure of your home, personal belongings, liability protection, and additional living expenses if your home becomes temporarily uninhabitable.
Home Exclusions: Standard home policies do not cover flood or earthquake damage. Separate endorsements or standalone policies must be purchased for these perils.

Claims Guidelines: To file a claim, policyholders must submit the First Notice of Loss (FNOL) within 48 hours of the incident via the mobile app or web portal. Required documentation includes police reports (for theft/accidents) and photographic evidence.
Claims Processing: Standard claims are processed within 5-7 business days. Complex claims requiring field adjusters may take up to 30 days for final resolution.
Underwriting Guidelines: Applicants aged 50+ seeking life insurance over $500,000 must undergo a mandatory paramedical exam including blood tests and EKG.
Regulatory Compliance: All agents must complete annual AML (Anti-Money Laundering) training and retain client communication records for a minimum of 7 years in accordance with state regulations.
